name: Anouska Leibovici
title: Corporate trainer and leadership coach
profile: Anouska is a corporate trainer and leadership coach with more than 24 years' experience in senior management, sales, marketing and hospitality. She has held director-level roles across the hotel and travel industry, including responsibility for 16 hotel loyalty programmes and more than 400 employees across the Middle East. She has trained with ISOC since 2017, delivering courses in public speaking, leadership and communication skills.

bullets: Delivers face-to-face and live online courses in public speaking, leadership, internal communications, communication strategy and reputation management

career.role: Director of sales, marketing and events

bullets: Established and ran a new company within the group, from feasibility study through sales strategy to team recruitment and management
Responsible for 16 hotel loyalty programmes across five-star properties in the Middle East, managing more than 400 employees and exceeding the regional profit budget by 22% in her final year
